content: Now that the prerequisite refactor is finished, I would love to revive PR #26413, which closes one of the remaining analysis gaps in undergrad.yaml. I've updated the branch, and the PR should be ready for a look.
The next natural follow-up is the compact-exit lemma ("exit theorem of a compact subspace" in undergrad.yaml), which I had compiling as PR #34849 but which needed a substantial refactor.

Thanks for taking a look, @Michael Rothgang. On splitting it into multiple PRs, I think this is easy to accomplish along module lines, i.e. ExistsUnique.lean additions in a prerequisite PR and then MaximalSolution.lean in its own PR. I don't quite see what the benefit would be of splitting up MaximalSolution.lean further, though. I'll start with this division, and if MaximalSolution.lean is too large to be reviewed on its own then I'll see what I can do.
